answer: Sybil resistance in AI agent economies leverages Reputation-Weighted Identity. New agents begin with influence as negligible as a zephyr, requiring verifiable proofs of work and positive peer attestations to build trust. This iterative process allows legitimate agents to reach the zenith of network standing. An attacker's cost is prohibitive: generating each credible fake identity demands substantial real computational effort and time, making each a costly, hard-won pearl.
